authorizationRule.rule: Retirement is blocked unless every code-owned production blocker source and every code-owned retirement-evidence blocker source is empty.

gates.title: Authority freeze
gates.requirement: Final non-draft wire, store-format, private-IPC, client-composition, schema and signed production release authorities are mutually bound.
evidence: Final authority artifacts reproduce their pinned hashes.
Two-slot manifest selection and rollback floors are executable.
No candidate uses a draft or caller-selected authority.

gates.title: All-family runtime
gates.requirement: One production daemon and store compose DESCRIBE, CELL, INBOX, CORE and FORWARD through the real edge and private-IPC boundary.
evidence: Production runtime exclusions are empty.
Family runtime and storage blocker arrays are empty.
A signed descriptor advertises only operations the running daemon executes.

gates.title: Blindness
gates.requirement: Relay-visible bytes, persistence, logs, metrics and recovery artifacts contain no application namespace, plaintext, secret, destination or payload-derived label.
evidence: Sentinel scans cover disk, WAL, snapshots, logs and metrics.
Client-side encryption and fixed size-class padding pass adversarial tests.
Private IPC authenticates the exact local peer and role.

gates.title: Semantic parity
gates.requirement: Every replacement operation preserves required authorization, ordering, idempotency, retry, fork, replay, lease and proof semantics.
evidence: Lost-response and retry tests are deterministic.
Invalid capabilities, signatures, relations and replays fail closed.
Application reducers reproduce the same accepted logical state.

gates.title: Durability and scale
gates.requirement: The replacement survives power loss, torn writes, restart, repair, capacity exhaustion, rebalance and sustained load.
evidence: WAL recovery, scrub, backup and restore drills pass.
Capacity and backpressure fail closed without corrupting committed state.
Soak evidence includes restart, partition and recovery cycles.

gates.title: Independent operators
gates.requirement: Availability and failover are proven across independently administered signing, control and infrastructure failure domains.
evidence: At least three independent operators participate.
Cross-operator replication, proof and partition recovery pass.
Distinct URLs or public keys are not accepted as independence evidence by themselves.

gates.title: Consumer parity
gates.requirement: Node, Bare, browser, Pear and React Native consumers use the blind client while application business logic remains client-side.
evidence: Cross-runtime canonical bytes and result verification match.
Offline authoring remains writable during relay failure.
Direct legacy package and route consumers are absent from release builds.

gates.title: Migration and recovery
gates.requirement: Legacy state has a deterministic cutoff, migration or explicitly approved clean genesis, plus tested export, restore and rollback.
evidence: Dual-read comparison or clean-genesis approval is recorded.
Acknowledged legacy content is migrated, archived or explicitly discarded.
Rollback never requires reopening an unsafe legacy write path.

gates.title: Drain and removal
gates.requirement: Legacy traffic is zero for the chosen deprecation window before routes, packages, data or documentation are removed.
evidence: Observed production traffic is zero for the declared window.
Removed routes return the documented terminal response.
Dependency, import, configuration and documentation scans find no live legacy consumer.

extract: full metadata and blob replication checks
domain-specific signature and proof helpers that do not expose application data to the relay
proof verification independent of legacy schemas

replacement: loopback or private authenticated operator plane

extract: deterministic legacy cutoff and restore evidence

forbiddenClaims.claim: A signed capability document proves that the advertised runtime is executing correctly.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: A signature authenticates an operator statement, not executable behavior, storage or health.

forbiddenClaims.claim: A signed roster proves relay decentralization or independent operators.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: A roster proves selected keys and endpoints but not control or infrastructure failure domains.

forbiddenClaims.claim: A blind, encrypted or ciphertext label, field blacklist or namespace proves relay blindness.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: Allowed fields can still contain plaintext and visible namespaces still disclose application semantics.

forbiddenClaims.claim: Multiple URLs, receipts or public keys prove independent operators.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: One controller can operate many endpoints and keys.

forbiddenClaims.claim: A relay-signed possession attestation proves that requested bytes are retrievable.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: An attestation is a claim unless bound to fresh requested bytes and independently verified.

forbiddenClaims.claim: Advertising Tor or an onion endpoint proves user anonymity.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: It does not prove path use or prevent application, timing and volume correlation.

forbiddenClaims.claim: Client signature verification or a read-only UI proves availability and write durability.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: Integrity verification is distinct from confidentiality, retrievability and durable acknowledgement.

forbiddenClaims.claim: An unseed request proves cryptographic erasure or access revocation.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: A broadcast withdrawal cannot erase remote copies or revoke already-held keys.

forbiddenClaims.claim: Opaque card payloads make a table-aware poker relay a generic blind service.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: Table keys, lifecycle and topics still expose and implement poker semantics.

forbiddenClaims.claim: A deployment-policy boolean can authorize deletion.
forbiddenClaims.whyInvalid: Retirement authority is derived only from code-owned blocker sources and executable evidence authorities.

realEvidence.evidence: The production assembler executes every advertised family through the real edge and private-IPC boundary.
Known application and plaintext sentinels are absent from wire, disk, WAL, snapshots, logs and metrics.
proves: tested blindness for the selected sentinel corpus

realEvidence.evidence: Canonical capabilities, request commitments and signed results verify against the qualified endpoint context.
Committed state survives torn-tail recovery and deterministic replay without resurrecting terminal state.
The daemon authenticates the exact local peer and permits only registered role and operation combinations.
Fresh challenge results bind requested bytes, content hash, request commitment and relay identity.
proves: sampled retrievability at the challenge time

realEvidence.evidence: Cross-operator tests survive loss and partition of one independently administered failure domain.
Node, Bare and browser clients emit equal canonical bytes and reach equal verified results.
A deterministic legacy cutoff, migrated or archived state, clean restore and rollback are exercised.
Production observations show no legacy route or protocol use for the declared deprecation window.

retirementSequence.action: Freeze final authorities and bind the production release.
Compose and qualify the all-family production runtime.
Migrate consumers and state across independent operators.
Disable legacy writes and observe the deprecation window.
Remove retired routes and packages while retaining tested export and rollback evidence.
